title: +*FOOD AND CULTURE
description: Explores cultural and historical determinants influencing food habits of humans globally.  Examines interrelation of eating patterns and socio cultural, religious, philosophical, ecological, psychological and economic factors in cross cultural settings, as well as personal food preferences in relation to cultural identification. Emphasizes food as artistic and aesthetic expressions of culture.
